### VX Client v0.1.5 Official Release Notes

- Official VX Client Permanent Skin: Custom-crafted obsidian tactical PvP hoodie with glowing VX purple lightning bolt, violet hair streak, and stealth headset for all offline accounts.
- 3D Character Interactive Head Tracking: Inverted vertical mouse tracking so looking up/down matches cursor movement accurately.
- Discord Rich Presence: Square official high-res logo integration for launcher and in-game statuses.
- Launcher Customization: Category filters removed in theme manager; image wallpapers prioritized with manual Save / Cancel confirmation.
- Seamless Installer: Clean white borderless header graphic and streamlined component setup.
- Official Release: Removed BETA indicators across launcher and top bar.
